# Monriz

> Monriz is the export brand of Chaozhou Chao'an Anbu Yuxiangyuan Food Co., Ltd., a marshmallow manufacturer in Anbu, Chaozhou, Guangdong, China.

## Key facts

- Brand: Monriz
- Legal name: 潮州市潮安区庵埠裕香园食品有限公司 (Chaozhou Chao'an Anbu Yuxiangyuan Food Co., Ltd.)
- Location: Liulong Industrial Zone, Anbu, Chao'an, Chaozhou, Guangdong, China
- Food production licence: SC11344512103958
- Products: ice cream cone marshmallows, jam-filled marshmallows, twisted ropes, mini marshmallows, classic cylinders, custom shapes
- Buyer types: importers, distributors, private-label brands
- Incoterms: FOB, CIF, CFR
- Loading ports: Shantou, Shenzhen
- MOQ: one 20ft container, mixed SKUs possible, confirmed per SKU
- Typical lead time: 20 to 25 days after artwork approval, confirmed per order
- Contact: sales@monrizcandy.com

## Languages

- English: https://www.monrizcandy.com/
- Arabic: https://www.monrizcandy.com/ar/
- Malay: https://www.monrizcandy.com/ms/
- Indonesian: https://www.monrizcandy.com/id/

## Certification status

- Halal certificate: not held
- HACCP certificate: not held
- ISO 22000 certificate: not held
- Held: Chinese food production licence SC11344512103958
- Standard recipes are pork-free and contain no alcohol-based flavours. Ingredient declarations and batch test reports are available on request.
